messages.text: Take the comment of PR #90 and tackle comment one: produce an obj file for chambers (blue) and coils (grey).
I’ll read the latest PR #90 comment and export the chamber and coil geometry as an OBJ, with blue chambers and grey coils.

The latest comment asks to start with the existing geometry, so I’ll keep this export limited to chambers and coils. The ACTS preflight still flags the old dependency record and missing staged DD4hep/Geant4 sources; I’m checking the rebuilt ACTS installation directly before using its OBJ exporter.

The ACTS OBJ writer builds successfully against the rebuilt installation. I’m using the actual finite chamber faces from the unchanged propagation geometry, plus the 36 toroid warm envelopes for reference. The export will include a companion MTL file for the blue and grey colours.

The export is generated: 1,560 blue chamber envelopes and 36 grey toroid envelopes. Checks confirm that every object is closed with consistent face winding, and the chamber corners match the source geometry to numerical precision. I’m packaging the OBJ and MTL together and adding them to PR #90.
The OBJ and MTL are packaged in a 1.6 MB ZIP with a relative material-file reference. A separate review is checking the files, colours and coil dimensions before I post the download links.

The existing propagation evidence still passes its hash checks. The OBJ adds no geometry changes: all six faces of each chamber are included, and the grey shapes show the existing toroid warm envelopes, including their case reservations.

The separate check passed: it confirmed the colours, chamber corners, all 36 coil placements and complete coil extents. It also verified that the ZIP contains the exact OBJ and MTL files. I’m posting the download links on PR #90.
The download links are live on PR #90. I’m pushing the final review and provenance records; the OBJ and MTL files themselves are unchanged from the checked export.

Created the [ZIP containing OBJ + MTL]([redacted]

- **1,560 blue chamber envelopes**
- **36 grey toroid coil envelopes**
- Coordinates in **metres**, with geometry unchanged.

Separate files: [OBJ]([redacted] · [MTL]([redacted] Keep them together for colours.

Mesh/material checks passed, and download links are posted on [PR #90](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/90#issuecomment-6276824797).
